title: Pure Exosister
summary: Pure Exosister Rank 4 Xyz control deck led by the 2026 Burst Protocol support (Exosister Betrayal and Exosister Karmael), with generic staples and Rank 4s. Every Main Deck Exosister pairs with a named partner and ranks up into an Exosister Xyz Monster on the spot whenever a card leaves either GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Exosister Martha Special Summons itself when you control no monsters (or only Xyz Monsters) and Special Summons Exosister Elis directly from your Deck.
Exosister Betrayal (2026 Burst Protocol support) adds two Exosister monsters to your hand, grants an extra Normal Summon of a named sister, and banishes cards sent to the opponent's GY.

Exosister Pax pays 800 LP at Quick-Play speed to search any Exosister card from the Deck—and if you search a monster whose named partner is on your field or in your GY, you can Special Summon it immediately.

summary.title: Opening: Exosister Martha (or Exosister Betrayal)
steps: Activate Exosister Martha in hand to Special Summon itself and Exosister Elis from the Deck (or activate Exosister Betrayal to add Exosister Stella and Exosister Elis and summon both).
Overlay Martha and Elis into Exosister Kaspitell (or Exosister Karmael); detach 1 material from Kaspitell to search Exosister Stella (or use Karmael to Set Exosister Returnia / Exosister Vadis).

Summon Exosister Stella and another sister (via Stella's hand summon or Betrayal's extra Normal Summon) to overlay into Exosister Mikailis, detaching 1 material to search Exosister Returnia or Exosister Pax.
Overlay Kaspitell and Mikailis into Rank 8 Exosisters Magnifica, and Set Returnia and Vadis to banish up to 4 cards on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Sister Pairs & Anti-GY Transformations
summary.text: The Main Deck sisters form two pairs—Exosister Elis with Exosister Stella, and Exosister Irene with Exosister Sophia (with Martha naming Elis)—that gain 800 LP when summoned alongside their partner. Whenever any card moves out of either GY by the opponent (or while Martha is on the field), each Main Deck sister can immediately Xyz Summon any Exosister Xyz Monster using only itself as material.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Exosisters Magnifica (Rank 8 made with 2 Rank 4 Exosister Xyzs) attacks twice each Battle Phase, detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to non-target banish 1 card your opponent controls, and chains to an opponent's activation by returning an attached Exosister Xyz to the Extra Deck to Xyz Summon it over Magnifica (triggering Exosister Mikailis to banish another card).
Exosister Karmael (Rank 4) Sets an Exosister Spell/Trap from the Deck and rewrites an opponent's activated effect into a harmless effect.

Exosister Mikailis banishes a card from the opponent's field or GY on the turn it is Xyz Summoned, Exosister Kaspitell locks both players out of Special Summoning from the GY for the turn, Exosister Asophiel locks out GY effect activations and bounces a monster, and Exosister Gibrine negates an opponent's Effect Monster.
Note: Exosister Martha and Exosister Vadis lock you into Special Summoning only Exosister monsters during the turn you use them.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Exosister Returnia pays 800 LP while all monsters you control are Exosisters to banish 1 card on the field or in the GY—and if you Xyz Summoned this turn (or resolve Exosister Vadis / Exosister Arment first), it banishes a second card on the field without targeting, or performs an immediate Exosister Xyz Summon.
Exosister Vadis pays 800 LP to Special Summon a named pair of Exosister monsters from the Deck, ready to transform as soon as the opponent touches either GY.

Exosister Arment Xyz Summons an Exosister Xyz over a single Exosister you control, and Exosister Carpedivem prevents your Exosisters from being targeted by Extra Deck monsters while declaring and negating a card name on Xyz Summon.

Summons itself on an empty field and pulls Elis from the Deck.

Summons another Exosister from the hand; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Irene
Swaps an Exosister in hand for a draw; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Sophia
Draws next to another Exosister; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.

Summons a named Exosister pair from the Deck.
Exosister Returnia
Banishes a card and Xyz Summons an Exosister on the spot.
